base-default.manifest:
[package]
name="combined-peer"
version="0.0.0"
edition="2021"
[features]
ours=["dep:meshoptimizer-rs"]
cpp=["dep:meshopt"]
rust=["dep:optimesh"]
[dependencies]
meshoptimizer-rs={package="meshoptimizer-rs",path="<target>/canonical",optional=true,default-features=false,features=["std", "clusterlod", "simd"]}
meshopt={version="=0.7.0",optional=true}
optimesh={version="=1.1.0",optional=true,default-features=false}
[profile.release]
lto="thin"
codegen-units=1
